title: Write and solve the dual
heading: A Row's Direction Sets the Sign of Its Price
cases: the dual of an LP with <= rows has the LP's optimal value, and its prices are the rows' prices
a >= row's price is at most zero, so a binding minimum gets a negative price
an == row's price is free, and here it is negative
an activity in no row still gets a cover row, 0 >= its value, so the dual is infeasible when the value is positive
an activity's cover row multiplies each row's price by the activity's coefficient in that row
